name: Low-poly Photo Art
description: Turn photos into editable triangle art and export PNG or true vector SVG
help: Pick an image and a feature-aware point set is triangulated automatically; every triangle samples its color from the photo.
In edit view click empty space to add points, drag points to reshape outlines and press the delete button to remove; corner anchors stay fixed so the canvas never loses a corner.
One drag counts as one step with undo / redo; the same seed and point count reproduce the same result.
Stroke width, brightness and output scale are adjustable before export; the SVG is a real polygon vector file, not an embedded bitmap.
